posts.cooked:
I am offering to do another group buy like I did with the previous promo pack (link here as a refresher), so register here if you are interested!

This groupbuy closes on Sunday 29th November

Now that we've passed the threshold of 20 members I've looked at estimating prices based on the number of packs ordered. There is a step up in the shipping cost every ten packs but the difference per pack is minimal with the quantity we are ordering. Numbers could end up a few pence out depending on final charges. We're at a point now where each additional backer is reducing the cost by about a penny so this is a good enough guideline to work from:

First copy
UK: £2.10
EU & Worldwide: £2.56
Each additional copy add £1.36

Note that this will be for the promos only in order not to push the shipping costs up. I'll maintain a list of participants below:
